segmente.text: Do you know why most skincare brands constantly launch new formulas?
Every few months they launch something fancy sounding like a Hydraactive Complex or a
BioLift Pro Repair. And it sounds like a scientific breakthrough, right?
But the only reason they do it is to sell more. Smart businesses use complexity to create curiosity.
If something sounds new or advanced, our brain assumes it must be better than what we already
have. That's the illusion of innovation. New cells, not because it is new, but because it feels new.
